subject: Exec: accelerated merit + equity refresh request — Sandip Rao
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Exec: accelerated merit + equity refresh request — Sandip Rao

Hi team,

I need an expedited exception for Sandip Rao (AE, EMEA). He has moved into a regional leadership-facing book after the org shift and materially outperformed quota the last two quarters. Manager recommends an accelerated merit increase and an equity refresh to maintain parity with peers and to avoid attrition risk.

Ask: exec approval for a +12% merit increase (effective immediately), a one-time RSU refresh ~40k USD (granted now, standard 4-year vest), and a one-time retention bonus of 7,500 USD. We would prefer the RSU grant be outside the regular cycle as an exception.

Rationale (summary):
- Quota attainment: 185% Q1, 162% Q2 YTD (post-org change).
- Key renewals: closed 3 strategic renewals that accelerated onboarding in EMEA region.
- Risk: competitor outreach; manager reports active headhunter engagement.

Attachments: comp_exception_form.pdf, salary_band_table.xlsx (band parity mapping).

Timelines: need final sign-off and payroll coding by COB Monday (2027-06-14) to include in the next payroll run and equity committee window.

Please advise next steps — who will take finance coding and legal clearance?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of SMB Sales, Redwood Inference
[rachel_kim@redwood.com]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec: accelerated merit + equity refresh request — Sandip Rao

Thanks Rachel — can you and Marissa answer a couple quick items so I understand the full ask before I greenlight?

1) Budget source: is this coming from the sales FY27 retention pool or from team variable? Please indicate GL code or planned charge.
2) Manager assessment: short narrative on behaviors, any PIP history, and recommended clawback/vesting schedule.
3) Is there a precedent for off-cycle RSU for EMEA AEs in the last 12 months? If so, point me to the approvals.

Monica — can you confirm the policy runway for an off-cycle RSU and whether we need legal sign-off for market adjustments in EMEA?

If we can get the items above by EOD, I can route this to Finance + Signatory and aim for decision by Monday.

-Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec: accelerated merit + equity refresh request — Sandip Rao

Vivek — thanks for the quick follow-up. Attaching a short manager assessment (manager_assessment.docx) and a proposed clawback clause. Answers inline below.

1) Budget source: this uses the sales retention pool (GL 540-RET-EMEA). We have 1.2M USD left in the pool after prior approvals; this ask fits within that allocation. (See linked salary_band_table.xlsx for parity impact).
2) Manager assessment (excerpt): Sandip has consistently exceeded expectations on deal execution, cross-functional influence, and coachability since his promotion. No PIP history. He led the renewal of three enterprise accounts that preserved ARR and expanded net-new ARR by 1.1M USD. Recommended clawback: 12 months pro-rated recapture if employee leaves within 12 months.
3) Precedent: In Q4 2026 we did two off-cycle RSU refreshes for EMEA AEs (campaign IDs in the shared drive).

Suggested implementation:
- Merit increase effective 2027-06-30 payroll.
- RSU grant signed within DocuSign link and issued in next equity grant window but marked as off-cycle.
- One-time bonus to be paid on next payroll run after approvals.

Attachments: manager_assessment.docx

-Marissa
Director, Sales Operations

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec: accelerated merit + equity refresh request — Sandip Rao

Thanks — quick checks from People Ops.

- Policy: Off-cycle RSU refreshes are allowed for retention risk and parity; they require executive sign-off + legal review for EMEA jurisdictions.
- Tax/Payroll: payroll-team@workday.com will need the GL code (Marissa supplied) and a completed comp_exception_form.pdf with signatures.
- DocuSign: I created a DocuSign packet for Sandip and legal review — https://docusign.com/abc123/topup-approval. Please review language on deferred vesting and clawback.
- Compliance: For certain EMEA countries we need local tax filings; our external counsel hr-legal@caprach-llp.com is on standby.

If Vivek approves, I can move to DocuSign and queue the payroll/RSU issuance. Recommend final sign-off by 2027-06-12 5pm PT to meet grant cutoff.

Attachments: hr_exception_checklist.pdf

Regards,
Monica Patel
People Ops Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec: accelerated merit + equity refresh request — Sandip Rao

Vivek — adding Ben from Finance to help with coding and timing. I've updated the DocuSign language to include the 12-month pro-rated clawback and clarified that the RSU grant is market-adjustment (outside standard cycle).

Ben — would you validate whether GL 540-RET-EMEA is the right charge and whether we can hit the payroll cutoff for a one-time bonus on the 6/30 cycle? If not, please propose the earliest alternative.

If everything looks good I will route the DocuSign to Vivek for signature.

Thanks,
Rachel

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Sandip Rao compensation exception

Approved.

Rachel — proceed with DocuSign and People Ops to finalize grants and bonus. Ben/Finance, charge to GL 540-RET-EMEA and confirm payroll timeline; if payroll cutoff is missed for 6/30, pay the one-time bonus on the first available run and note in the payroll journal.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer
